rule: Each candidate trained once with seed 0 on the fixed engine split. Select the candidate with the lowest validation RMSE (cycles, capped RUL). The test set is not used for selection.
budget: 4 trials per neural architecture, 3 trials for the baseline; no further search after this plan
shared_settings: Adam lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-5, batch 256, max 100 epochs, early-stopping patience 10
ablation: On the selected neural architecture: dropout set to 0.0, all other settings unchanged, seeds 0-2, validation data only
